CHAPTER.VERS: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it isfor brothers to live together in unity!
It is like the precious oil on the head,that ran down on the beard,even Aaron's beard;that came down on the edge of his robes;
like the dew of Hermon,that comes down on the hills of Zion:for there gives the blessing,even life forevermore.
